markets.rules_secondary:
The following market refers to TB Buccaneers D/ST in the Tampa Bay vs Dallas professional football game originally scheduled for Oct 8, 2026. If TB Buccaneers D/ST is active but never takes a snap, the market settles to the fair market price before game start. Once TB Buccaneers D/ST takes at least one snap, even if nullified by penalty, the market settles based on touchdowns scored. If no touchdowns are scored in the game, the No Touchdown market resolves to Yes and all other player markets resolve to No.
